lines.en: I hang under a leaf and swing with the wind.
I cannot walk; I can only sway.
A gust swings me across.
My silk hook is caught on the vein.

lines.zh: 叶尖往下弯，我就滑一点。
lines.en: The leaf tip dips and I slide a little.
In a whole day I moved half an inch.
The twig trembles and so do I.
I press to the leaf and turn slowly.
The dew weighs me lower.
I have no feet, only silk.
Rain strikes my shell and I rock.
I swing from the leaf edge to its middle.
My shell is tougher than it looks.

lines.zh: 我随叶子的方向转过去。
lines.en: I turn whichever way the leaf turns.
The wind over these plains is steady.
I sag slowly, then catch again.

lines.zh: 草原的蛹，被风吹得发亮。
lines.en: A savanna chrysalis, polished by wind.
Something inside is slowly changing.

lines.zh: 阳光透过叶子照在我身上。
lines.en: Sunlight comes through the leaf onto me.
There is a fine seam on my shell.
I neither eat nor drink, nor need to.
It is noisy out there; I pay no mind.
A hot wind crosses the savanna.
My shape is longer than before.

lines.zh: 一只蚂蚁爬过我，又走了。
lines.en: An ant crawls over me and moves on.
I count the leaf's swaying.
Do not move me; I am busy.
You cannot move me, can you.
I cannot see you well from in here.
Come closer and the leaf will swing.
I have hung over these plains a long time.

lines.zh: 你听见壳里的小声音了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear the small sound inside?
You will have to wait a while.

lines.zh: 我出来的时候会不一样。
lines.en: When I come out, I will be different.
My shell is pressed.

lines.zh: 这一下让我裂了一道纹。
lines.en: That left a hairline crack.
I cannot cry out, nor flee.
The pain makes me clench.
It is stifling inside.
Touch me again and I fall.
A crack in the shell; I can't move.
I only hope to finish changing soon.
I do not eat; thank you.
I have no way to eat what you offer.
Even my mouth is being remade.
Do not leave it beside me.
That smell does not get through the shell.
I need only sun and wind.
You hold it up and I cannot see.
Put it away; it draws insects.

lines.zh: 我这一阶段什么都不吃。
lines.en: At this stage I eat nothing at all.
You touch the leaf and I swing.
The bump tilts my silk hook.
I can neither strike back nor run.
That nearly shook me loose.
My silk still holds; it is fine.
I knock against the leaf, lightly.
The shell is hard; it does not hurt.

lines.zh: 你走过带起的风让我转。
lines.en: The wind of your passing turns me.
I caught hold again; lucky.

lines.zh: 我这形态做不了这种事。
lines.en: In this form I cannot do such a thing.
Wait until I have emerged.
Do not ask a chrysalis that.
I do not even have legs yet.
At this stage I am only responsible for changing.
You ask too early.
There is no room in here.
I hang quietly and do not answer.
The wind took that away.
I am hooked to the vein; I cannot be taken.
Players cannot move me; I know.
You reach out, and I only sway.
My silk hook is firm.
Pick the leaf and I go with it.
Do not pull; it will snap.

lines.zh: 我挂在这儿是有原因的。
lines.en: There is a reason I hang here.
Lower your hand and I settle.
This leaf is my place.
No one can carry me off.
A shadow passed beyond the leaf.
Something is walking on the branch.

lines.zh: 我的壳朝那个方向侧着。
lines.en: My shell is angled that way.
I cannot move; I can only wait.
It touched the leaf.
I heard it from inside the shell.
I draw myself in a little.

lines.zh: 它要是咬开壳，我就完了。
lines.en: If it bites the shell open, I am done.
Its smell is strong.
A shadow circles beyond the leaf.
It has stopped, right below.
I dare not make a sound.
It moves again, that way.

lines.zh: 我的壳在阳光下很显眼。
lines.en: My shell stands out in the sun.
It sniffs and moves away.
I am still here, undiscovered.
The wind has shifted here.
I waited a long time before it left.

lines.zh: 蛹壳里，我什么也做不了。
lines.en: Inside the chrysalis, I can do nothing.
I can only sway, and it does not move it.
It bit the shell.
A white mark is left on the shell.

lines.zh: 我里面的身子缩成一团。
lines.en: The body inside curls into a ball.
The leaf stalk flicks it.
I pull the shell tighter.
It backs off as the leaf swings.
I have no strength to resist.
Good; it has gone.
I have fastened myself under a leaf.
The caterpillar left me here.
This is the first time I see the plains.
Wind comes off the grass tips.
I hang low, but securely.
Plenty of sun here; just right.
The shell warms; wings stir.
The leaf is trembling slightly.
I hear insects far off.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的壳，丝快断了。
lines.en: Fire bakes my shell; the silk is parting.
I have fallen from the leaf.

lines.zh: 水浸进壳里，里面全湿了。
lines.en: Water seeps in; the inside is soaked.
The blast tears me off the leaf.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的壳，划开一道。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my shell and splits it.

lines.zh: 那股力量从丝钩传进来。
lines.en: That force comes in through the silk hook.

lines.zh: 我不用吃，可我也撑不久。
lines.en: I need no food, but I cannot last long either.
Lightning flashes and my shell goes hot.
The leaf and I fall together.
